target.title: fix(telegram): pass proxy and apiRoot config when resolving runtime target usernames
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
When resolving outbound username targets during message routing/delivery (`resolveTelegramTargets`), the call to `lookupTelegramChatId` failed to pass the account's configured `proxyUrl` and `apiRoot`. This caused target lookup requests to bypass proxy settings or fail in restricted networks.

This PR updates the `lookupTelegramChatId` invocation in `resolveTelegramTargets` to pass the `proxyUrl` and `apiRoot` from the Telegram account configuration.

## Evidence
Passed tests on branch `fix/5.3-telegram-runtime-target-resolution-proxy`:
```
 ✓ |extension-telegram| extensions/telegram/src/channel.resolve-targets.test.ts (1 test) 7ms
```
